title: weekly-sync-serving-runtime-infra-console-prep-2026-03-30-evan-scratchpad
content:
Weekly sync prep notes (serving-runtime / infra / console) - 2026-03-30
Owner: Evan Chen
Context: quick cross-team sync. Keep to 45m. Focus on rollout readiness for v1.7 kernels, infra capacity for dedicated pools, and console rollout telemetry.
Attendees (expected): Maya, Carlos, Jin, Priya (console), Rahul (sre), Evan

AGENDA (draft)
1) Quick wins / shoutouts (3m)
   - Maya: autoscaler bugfix merged yesterday
   - Jin: perf regression on 2x seq-length repro, fix in branch

2) Rollout status: runtime v1.7 kernels (10m)
   - Current state: canary on 2 clusters (asia-east1, us-west2), 10% traffic.
   - Metrics to watch: p95 latency, error-rate, memory OOMs, kernel fallback rate.
   - Known issue: tokenization mismatch for one small model (ENG-4123) causing fallback to CPU for ~5% requests.
   - Decision needed: continue canary to 50% or pause and hotfix?
   - Prep notes: if fallback rate >8% we pause. Have rollback playbook ready (CONFLUENCE-ServingRuntime-Runbook).

3) Dedicated capacity forecasts & infra (10m)
   - Capacity ask from sales: +4 A100s reserved for Q2 trials starting 2026-04-15.
   - Infra constraints: cluster autoscaler currently limited by GPU quota in us-west2 (ticket opened with cloud provider).
   - Action: Carlos to confirm quota increase ETA; fallback plan to shift trials to us-east1.

4) Console telemetry & rollout (8m)
   - Console rollout scheduled next week. Need to ensure traces and token-level cost logs are enabled for canary customers.
   - Privacy checklist: ensure KMS keys are used for private deployments in logs (Priya to confirm).
   - Action: Jin to add a short trace field to the user-level payload to correlate inference requests with console events.

5) Open blockers / risks (8m)
   - SRE: intermittent node failures after nightly maintenance window (rahul). Likely kernel driver mismatch.
   - Observability: missing token-cost breakdown for multi-model routing cases; affects billing accuracy for dedicated customers.

6) AOB & quick sync on tickets (6m)

PREP NOTES / TALKING POINTS
- For rollout decision: stress metric thresholds (p95 +200ms, error-rate >0.5%, fallback >8%). Recommend to continue canary if none breached; else pause and roll back.
- Be ready to propose short-term mitigation (force quantized variant for affected model) if tokenization mismatch persists.
- Confirm Dedicated capacity ETA before committing to customer trials; set expectation with sales to 'tentative until quota confirmed'.

CURRENT ACTION ITEMS (captured in meeting)
- ACTION-01: Carlos Rivera -> Confirm GPU quota increase with cloud provider and update infra channel. DUE: 2026-03-31. STATUS: assigned.
- ACTION-02: Jin Park -> Add trace correlation field to console payload, push PR for review. DUE: 2026-04-02. STATUS: in_progress. LINK: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/233
- ACTION-03: Maya Singh -> Monitor canary kernel fallback rate and report p95/error-rate at EOD daily. DUE: ongoing until rollout decision. STATUS: active.
- ACTION-04: Priya Patel -> Validate KMS config for console telemetry for private deployments, confirm with security. DUE: 2026-04-01. STATUS: assigned.
- ACTION-05: Evan Chen -> Prepare rollback runbook snippet for v1.7 canary and circulate to SRE+Release. DUE: 2026-03-30 (EOD). STATUS: drafting. LINK: CONFLUENCE-ServingRuntime-Runbook

NOTES / SCRATCH (to self)
- Quick checklist to bring to meeting: canary dashboard link, recent deploy logs, top 3 failing request IDs.
- Remind release engineering to hold off merging any unrelated runtime changes until canary finishes.
- Follow up with sales on trial commitments: ask for flexible start date in case of quota delay.

FOLLOW-UPS AFTER MEETING (what I need to do)
- Finalize rollback snippet and post to #release-eng.
- Triage ENG-4123 with Jin and Maya — figure out root cause for tokenization mismatch.
- If quota not confirmed by 3/31, schedule short call with sales + infra to replan trial region.

OTHER LINKS / REFERENCES
- Canary dashboard: https://internal.redwood.ai/dashboards/canary-v1-7
- Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SRV/Serving+Runtime+Runbook
- Jira: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENG-4123

END
